description: Confirmed measles cases by state from CDC. With a state: its cases this year, last year and the year before, its rank, and its kindergarten MMR coverage. Without a state: every state ranked by cases this year and the states with none. New York City is reported separately from the rest of New York State; "NY" adds both.

state.description: State name or two-letter code, "New York City", "New York State" or "DC". Omit for all states.

top.description: How many states to list in the summary when no state is given. Default 15.

year.description: Year, one of the last three. Default the current year.

name: measles_cases_by_state
title: Measles cases by state
